Package test

Class ParallelAgent

java.lang.Object
test.ParallelAgent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Agent
public class ParallelAgent extends Object implements Agent
Decorator that wraps any Agent and executes its callbacks on a dedicated background thread (Active Object pattern).

When callback(String, Message) is called from a publisher's thread, the message is placed in a bounded blocking queue and the call returns immediately. A single worker thread drains the queue and calls the wrapped agent's callback sequentially, ensuring that the underlying agent never needs to be thread-safe.

The worker thread is a daemon thread, so it does not prevent JVM shutdown, but close() should still be called explicitly to drain remaining messages and release resources cleanly.

    • ParallelAgent

      public ParallelAgent(Agent agent, int capacity)
      Creates a ParallelAgent wrapping the given agent with a queue of the specified capacity.
      Parameters:
      agent - the agent to wrap; must not be null
      capacity - maximum number of messages the queue can hold before callback(java.lang.String, test.Message) blocks; must be positive
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if agent is null or capacity is not positive

      public void reset()
      Resets the agent's internal state to its initial values. Called automatically by close() and may also be invoked manually between test runs. Delegates to the wrapped agent's Agent.reset().

    • callback

      public void callback(String topic, Message msg)
      Enqueues the message for asynchronous delivery to the wrapped agent. Returns immediately; the actual callback runs on the worker thread. Silently ignores null inputs or calls made after close().
      Specified by:
      callback in interface Agent
      Parameters:
      topic - the topic name

    • close

      public void close()
      Stops the worker thread and releases all resources.

      Sets the active flag to false, interrupts the worker thread (in case it is blocked on take()), waits for it to finish, then closes the wrapped agent.

      Specified by:
      close in interface Agent
